title: Tap Race
blurb: Tap the button as many times as you can in 15 seconds.

title: Lettuce Slots
blurb: Just spin, or make a run: every spin grows the bowl. Serve it before the bunny does.

title: Totodile's Pond
blurb: A pond that keeps going while you're away.

title: Keto Krush
blurb: A match-3 about meat, cheese, bread, and knowing which is which.

title: Daily Letters
blurb: Same 19 letters for everyone. Fewest left over wins. Honor system on the words.

title: Open Gym
blurb: Sign the whole neighborhood before the rival chain does. Turn-based turf war.

title: Zorro Runner
blurb: Endless runner. Jump, slide, and swing past everything Spanish California throws at you.

title: Fat Finger Fit
blurb: Eight days, four sliders a day, locked one at a time. Your thumb is not as precise as you think.
